legalityPolicy.allowed: Pre-run tuning may select static hyperparameters and runtime knobs before the leaderboard-timed run.
legalityPolicy.forbidden: Do not carry pretrained weights, validation-derived state, paid-prefix data, or external downloads into the timed artifact.

searchSpaces.expectedSignal: Find dense-control static parameter values worth promoting to one-H100 rehearsal without carrying learned state across runs.
searchSpaces.expectedDecision: Promote a value only if it improves early bpb, tokens/sec, or artifact headroom versus dense control.
searchSpaces.promotionGate: early bpb improves or tokens/sec improves without artifact-budget regression
searchSpaces.eightH100PromotionGate: only after one-H100 tuning evidence beats dense control and remains reproducible across seeds
searchSpaces.retirementCriteria: Retire dominated values after one bounded rehearsal or earlier if artifact budget is exceeded.
stopConditions: Stop if early validation is worse and tokens/sec does not improve
Stop if runtime exceeds the bounded rehearsal cap

searchSpaces.expectedSignal: Find sparse window and block-size values that preserve local/global sparse signal while exposing kernel-friendly block structure.
searchSpaces.expectedDecision: Promote only layouts that keep bpb competitive with token-local sparse attention and improve memory or kernel-readiness signal.
searchSpaces.promotionGate: no causal leakage and no bpb regression without throughput or memory-headroom upside
searchSpaces.eightH100PromotionGate: only after one-H100 block sparse evidence justifies kernel implementation or 8xH100 rehearsal
searchSpaces.retirementCriteria: Retire block layouts dominated by local/global sparse attention.
stopConditions: Stop if bpb regresses without memory or throughput gain
Stop if artifact budget is exceeded

searchSpaces.expectedSignal: Find a Local-SGD averaging period that improves 8xH100 tokens/sec without unstable early validation.
searchSpaces.expectedDecision: Promote sync periods only when tokens/sec improves over DDP and early bpb remains stable.
searchSpaces.promotionGate: tokens/sec improves by at least 10% without early bpb collapse
searchSpaces.eightH100PromotionGate: this is already an eight-H100 tuning lane; promote only static sync periods with stable evidence
searchSpaces.retirementCriteria: Retire sync periods that require optimizer-state averaging to avoid divergence unless speedup remains positive.
stopConditions: Stop if tokens/sec does not improve over DDP
Stop if optimizer-state averaging removes the speedup
